name: draytek-exporter
description: Prometheus exporter for DrayTek Vigor modems/routers (Vigor 167, v5 firmware). Scraped at http://<ip>:9103/metrics. Set DRAYTEK_PASSWORD to the router login password and adjust the post-deploy parameters: --target=<router ip> (default 192.168.0.1) and optionally --username=<router user> (defaults to 'monitor').

variables.name: Router Password: DRAYTEK_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password used to authenticate to the DrayTek router (read from the env var named by --password-env, default DRAYTEK_PASSWORD)
